source.title: Handtevy Inventory
notes: Transcribed from the one-page PDF handtevy_inventory.pdf. The sheet prints no title, no date and no revision; the title here is the file's name and version_label is "undated", as on the airway bag list.

Two item blocks sit side by side: the left half is Top Insert, Bottom Bin, < 1 Y/O (Grey / Pink / Red) and 1 year (Purple); the right half is 2 year (Yellow), 3 & 4 years (White), 5 & 6 year (Blue), 7 & 8 year (Orange) and 9 - 13 year (Green). Items are in that reading order. The iGels row is last in the Bottom Bin; the PDF text layer lists it last on the page, the picture shows it above the < 1 Y/O heading.

The Amount and Need columns are empty on the sheet. The sheet prints one rule at the bottom right (white on black): "Quantity 1 unless indicated in ( )". min_text is that printed per-item quantity: the number in ( ) when a size has one, otherwise 1. Nothing else was assumed.

A row that lists several sizes is split into one item per printed size (variant_group / variant_label). Where the row gives a quantity in ( ) it is that size's quantity, e.g. "IV Catheter - 18Ga, 20Ga, 22Ga(2 each)" is 2 of each gauge; "Needles - 21Ga 1"(2), 25Ga 1" (1 each)" is 2 of 21Ga and 1 of 25Ga; "ET Tube - 6.5mm, 7.0mm Cuffed(1 each)" is 1 of each. A multi-size row with no quantity (for example "Syringes - 1cc, 3cc, 10cc") is read as 1 of each size.

The < 1 Y/O block is printed across the Grey, Pink and Red color columns. Its rows are kept as printed under one color_band ("Grey / Pink / Red (< 1 year)") and every item in it is flagged for review: the sheet does not say which size goes with which color.
color_band on the other blocks is the printed color and age group of that block. Top Insert and Bottom Bin print no color name.

Sizes written with a mm, F, Ga or cc value share a catalog item with the same size on the bag and vehicle lists (for example ET tube 4.5 cuffed, OPA 60mm, NPA 20F, IV catheter 18 gauge, i-gel 2.5). Items with no exact match have their own catalog key.

review_notes: The sheet prints no title, date or revision, so version_label is "undated". If a revision date exists elsewhere it should be added.
< 1 Y/O block: the rows span the Grey, Pink and Red columns and the sheet does not say which size belongs to which color. All 13 items in the block are flagged for review.

Rows that list several sizes with no quantity (for example "Syringes - 1cc, 3cc, 10cc", "French Catheter- 6F,8F", "Blade - 2 Straight & Curved") are read as 1 of each size. A person should confirm that 1 per size, not 1 per row, is meant.
